Event: `ad3dc5c9970c8fa812cf1ffa4c6511b9` · 2026-09-24T08:18:17Z

> Full detail:
> 
> Delivered:
> - libs/wire/src/proto/startup.rs: reverted the hand-rustfmt from ef6751a1a; regenerated via `cargo run -p redoubt-wire-gen`; `--check` clean.
> - stub/src/lib.rs: fixed a real build blocker -- redoubt-wire declares `extern crate alloc` (only its JSON parser allocates; typed decoding, which read_image uses, never does), so linking it into a no_std/no_main binary needs *some* #[global_allocator] even though nothing calls one. Added a zero-sized NullAlloc, instantiated once per [[bin]] (stub + fixture-child), documented SAFETY (alloc/dealloc unreachable). Closed the 5 review-round-1 P2s, each with a host test:
>   1. e_machine/class check -> BadImage::WrongMachine (test: plan_refuses_a_non_riscv_machine)
>   2. p_align power-of-two + vaddr/offset congruence -> BadImage::BadAlign (test: plan_refuses_a_misaligned_p_align)
>   3. segment-vs-segment overlap (previously only checked vs image/exclude) -> BadImage::Overlaps (test: plan_refuses_two_segments_that_overlap_each_other)
>   4. entry point must lie in an executable PT_LOAD -> BadImage::EntryNotExecutable (test: plan_refuses_an_entry_outside_any_executable_segment)
>   5. image_len cap: MAX_IMAGE_LEN = STUB_ENTRY (~512MiB, MEMORY-LAYOUT's own link-space bound), checked in read_image -> BadStartup::BadImage (test: read_image_refuses_an_image_len_over_the_cap)
> - stub/src/main.rs: added `fence.i` before jr (icache/dcache coherence: map_segment writes code via copy_nonoverlapping, ordinary stores, which Zifencei requires an explicit fence.i to order against instruction fetch). Moved process_exit into lib.rs, shared with fixture-child, cfg-gated to riscv32/64 (host tests don't have redoubt_sys::syscall).
> - stub/src/bin/fixture-child.rs: broke when redoubt-rt moved to [dev-dependencies] in the parked round (plain `cargo build` for a [[bin]] doesn't get dev-deps -- E0433 unresolved redoubt_rt). Fixed by giving it its own #[panic_handler] and using the shared stub::process_exit/NullAlloc instead of restoring redoubt-rt as a normal dependency (which would reintroduce the duplicate panic_handler/global_allocator conflict main.rs was rewritten to avoid).
> - stub/fuzz/fuzz_targets/plan.rs + Cargo.lock: added the 3 new BadImage variants to the exhaustive match arm; lockfile reflects the dependency change (redoubt-rt out, redoubt-wire in).
>
